writeup: TIC 59387976 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 22.5190 days. The primary eclipse causes the star to dim by 13.35 percent, and a secondary eclipse has been detected at a significance level of 7.6 sigma, occurring at orbital phase 0.46. The detection shows strong statistical confidence, with a BLS signal-to-noise ratio of 230.6 and pixel-level analysis confirming a peak signal-to-noise of 103.6. The automated pipeline assigned this candidate a machine-learning screening score of 0.82, indicating high confidence that this represents a real eclipsing system. Notably, this candidate does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs, making it a new find for further study.
